question: DN-DETR 用什么附加训练任务缓解二分图匹配不稳定？
boundary: 同一真实证据与参数的生成复测；最终Agent整链路另测。回放耗时不是模型生成耗时。

result.answer:
## 回答
DN-DETR 通过向 Transformer 解码器额外输入噪声化的 ground-truth (GT) 标签和框，并训练模型重建这些 ground-truth 信息来缓解二分图匹配的不稳定性。[参考文档1：dino.pdf；第5页（物理页码）][参考文档2：dn\_detr.pdf；第8页（物理页码）]

原文依据："It shows that the slow convergence problem in DETR is caused by the instability of bipartite matching. To mitigate this problem, DN-DETR proposes to additionally feed noised ground-truth (GT) labels and boxes into the Transformer decoder and train the model to reconstruct the ground-truth ones." [参考文档1：dino.pdf；第5页（物理页码）]
